Name: Sepak Venuses
Overview:
Come and join us! Let's play volley ball by foot! You can play various actions with using a stick and a button simply.

Free play: 1st and 2nd set is won by 15 points, third is won by 6 points. A team to win two sets win the match.

Tour: Win ten matches each of which is won by a set, which is won by 6 points. You play this mode and will get new costumes.
